message.content: {"note_claim": "The video shows US Air Force C-17 Globemaster IIIs airdropping aid, not Chinese planes.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Investigations into the footage reveal that most of the clips circulating online actually show a United States aid airdrop over Beit Lahiya, northern Gaza, from March 2024.", "reason": "The page directly confirms that the viral videos show a US C-17 airdrop, not Chinese aircraft, and explicitly states China does not operate the C-17."}

parsed.note_claim: The video shows US Air Force C-17 Globemaster IIIs airdropping aid, not Chinese planes.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Investigations into the footage reveal that most of the clips circulating online actually show a United States aid airdrop over Beit Lahiya, northern Gaza, from March 2024.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms that the viral videos show a US C-17 airdrop, not Chinese aircraft, and explicitly states China does not operate the C-17.
